text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Moslem fasting month starts on Friday.
- Foreign Minister Sheikh Sabah al-Ahmad al-Sabah receives message from Iranian counterpart.

- Government agenda would solve the issue of stateless people living in Kuwait, planning minister says. Some 100,000 stateless people, mainly Arabs, live in Kuwait and claim Kuwaiti nationality. The government says most of them have concealed their original nationalities seeking social benifits and services guaranteed for Kuwaitis.
- Kuwait's National Guards end joint exercise with U.S. marines.
- Foreign minister sends messages to Bahraini and Qatari ministers.
- Parliament panel votes to air parliamentary debates.
- Ministry of higher education considers creating second university.
- Kuwait's top judge says judicial system fully independent.
- Share index falls in active trade.
